protocol.title: Microfluidic Probe for Single-Cell Analysis in Adherent Tissue Culture
protocol.platform: Three-layer PDMS microfluidic probe with hydrodynamic confinement lysis, pneumatic valves, and nanolitre reaction chambers
cell_lines: MCF-7 (human breast cancer, used for single-cell lysis characterisation only)
protocol.objective: Selective lysis of single adherent cells from standard tissue culture by hydrodynamic confinement, capture of single-cell lysate, and multiplexed fluorescence activity measurement of kinase Akt (Sox sensor) and housekeeping enzyme GAPDH (NADH formation) simultaneously from the same cell; demonstration of biological heterogeneity in Akt activity under insulin stimulation correlating with cell morphology subgroups

layers: Layer 1 (base): bare glass slide, forms base except at tip
Layer 2 (membrane): ~30 um thin PDMS; forms deformable tip base; contains pneumatic valve lines V1-V4
Layer 3 (flow): ~5 mm thick PDMS; contains channels, reaction chambers AB1-AB4, flow and control ports

tip.notes: L = w + 2p = 100 + 2x50 = 200 um. Tip cut with sharp microtome blade to pointed flat front.

lysis_zone.principle: Hydrodynamic confinement of detergent (1% Triton X-100) to a zone of radius R
lysis_zone.zone_radius_R: slightly smaller than cell diameter (~15 um)
lysis_zone.confinement_simulation: COMSOL Multiphysics (Laminar Flow + Transport of Dilute Species); detergent diffusivity 6e-11 m2/s; input 1% v/v
lysis_zone.notes: R/L tunable by Qin/Qout ratio. Lysis zone high-detergent (1% v/v); surrounding surface sees zero detergent. Neighbouring cells unaffected even at ~80% confluency.

mixing.set_by: flow resistance ratio of lysate and assay buffer microchannels

valves.actuation: compressed air, 30 psi, via custom-built solenoid valve manifold
valves.timing: actuated at 90 s after lysis (travel time from tip to chamber)

chambers.parallel_capacity: up to 4 cells in parallel (one per chamber); lysis sequential per cell

fabrication.mask_design: AutoCAD 2000; transferred to photoplot film or chrome mask

photolithography.flow_layer_30um_channels: AZ4620 photoresist on 6 inch silicon wafer

fabrication.silanisation: Heptadecafluoro-1,1,2,2-tetra-hydrodecyl trimethoxysilane; dessicator 1 min vent + 1 h vacuum
fabrication.pdms_flow_layer: RTV615 5:1; cast from silicon mould then plastic replica mould
fabrication.partial_cure: 60 min at 65 C; aligned under stereo microscope; baked overnight at 65 C for monolithic bond
fabrication.final_assembly: plasma bonded to glass slide; tip protruding over straight edge; baked 95 C 15 min; degassed >= 10 min

reagents.culture_medium: Eagle's Minimal Essential Medium + 10% FBS (Hyclone, Fisher Scientific) + 1% penicillin/streptomycin (Invitrogen)
reagents.cell_tracker_dye: Cell Tracker Orange (Invitrogen), 2.5 uM in serum-free medium; rhodamine filter ex 540 nm / em 570 nm
reagents.insulin: 500 ng/mL final concentration in serum-free medium
reagents.bsa_coating: 1% BSA in 0.5x PBS; drawn in at 50 nL/min for >= 1 h; prevents non-specific protein binding to PDMS
reagents.di_water: de-ionised water; device priming and BSA wash

lysis_buffer.composition: 50 mM beta-glycerophosphate, 10 mM sodium pyrophosphate, 30 mM sodium fluoride, 50 mM Tris pH 7.4, 1% Triton X-100, 15 mM NaCl, 2 mM EGTA, 100 uM sodium orthovanadate, 1 mM DTT, 1X protease inhibitor cocktail (Merck/EMD 539134), 1X phosphatase inhibitor cocktail (Sigma P2850), 20 ug/mL Alexa 488-labelled BSA (lysis zone visualisation)
lysis_buffer.syringes: gas-tight glass syringes 50 uL; fused silica tubing OD 360 um / ID 100 um

akt_assay_buffer.composition: 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.3, 10 mM MgCl2, 1 mM EGTA, 2 mM DTT, 4 mM PKC inhibitor peptide, 10 mM Sox substrate peptide, 1 mM ATP (low metals grade, Calbiochem), 0.4 mM PKItide, 5 uM GF109203X (EMD)
akt_assay_buffer.readout: Sox chelation-enhanced fluorescence; DAPI filter ex 377 nm / em 447 nm (Semrock)

gapdh_assay_buffer.composition: 90 mM sodium pyrophosphate pH 7.1, 20 mM NaH2PO4, 3 mM DTT, 4 mM NAD+, 10 mM glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate
gapdh_assay_buffer.readout: NADH fluorescence; DAPI filter ex 377 nm / em 447 nm (Semrock)
gapdh_assay_buffer.notes: LOD lower than Akt due to higher GAPDH expression levels. CV of bulk GAPDH lysate measurements within 18%.

mk2_assay_buffer.composition: same as Akt assay buffer but 25 uM GF109203X instead of 5 uM
mk2_assay_buffer.notes: Analogous LOD to Akt (Supplementary Fig. 7). Not encoded in this .bs file (separate single-activity arm).

steps.name: Device priming with de-ionised water
steps.tubing: fused silica OD 360 um / ID 100 um; gas-tight glass syringes 50 uL
steps.notes: Primed via lysis buffer and inflow source ports. Removes air bubbles and equilibrates channels before BSA coating.

steps.name: BSA coating to prevent non-specific protein binding
steps.notes: 1% BSA in 0.5x PBS. Critical to preserve picomolar single-cell lysate enzyme activity. Washed with DI water after 1 h.

steps.name: UV photobleaching of observation area
steps.operation: heat (25 C, UV light exposure abstraction)
steps.notes: Area of device observed during assay bleached for >= 30 min to reduce background fluorescence in reaction chambers. Done immediately before loading assay buffers.

steps.name: Load assay buffers and lysis buffer into device reservoirs
steps.notes: Lysis buffer loaded into syringe at lysis buffer port. Akt buffer into AB1, GAPDH buffer into AB2, each 20 uL. Done immediately before experiment.

steps.name: HepG2 cell plating and attachment
steps.duration_note: 4 h minimum (range 4-16 h); 240m in BioScript (IR: 14400.0 SECOND)
steps.notes: No changes in insulin activation time course observed for seeding densities 15,000-100,000 cells/cm2 (bulk assay data). Cells allowed to fully attach before serum starvation.

steps.name: Serum starvation
steps.duration_note: 12 h minimum (range 12-24 h); 720m in BioScript (IR: 43200.0 SECOND)
steps.notes: Synchronises Akt signalling baseline. Required to sensitise Akt pathway to insulin stimulation. For bulk assay: starved 16-24 h.

steps.name: Cell labelling with Cell Tracker Orange dye
steps.operation: mix + heat (37 C) + PBS wash + recovery
steps.duration_note: Labelling 15m minimum (range 15-45 m; IR: 900.0 SECOND). Recovery 20m minimum (range 20-45 m; IR: 1200.0 SECOND).
steps.notes: Cytosolic dye; fluorescence drop in target cell confirms lysis and lysate capture. Neighbouring cell fluorescence remains constant throughout lysis event.

steps.name: Insulin stimulation to activate Akt
steps.method: spiked into serum-free medium on plate; medium NOT removed during time-course lysis
steps.duration_note: 10 min minimum tested (range 10-16.5 min; IR: 600.0 SECOND)
steps.notes: For time-course: cells lysed one by one off plate under continuous stimulation conditions. For serum-starved control: no insulin, no medium change. Serum-starved control cells show lower/absent Akt activity ('low Akt' phenotype).

steps.name: Single-cell lysis by hydrodynamic confinement
steps.operation: mix (simultaneous Qout/Qin tip flow abstraction) + detect lysisDetection
steps.notes: Plate placed on microscope immediately after stimulation. Probe positioned near target cell. Lysis confirmed by Cell Tracker Orange fluorescence drop in target cell. Neighbouring cells confirmed unaffected (fluorescence constant). Lysate captured within ~20 s.

steps.name: Lysate transport, valve actuation, and Akt kinase assay (chamber AB1)
steps.operation: mix (resistance-ratio passive mixing) + heat (30 C) + detect aktKinaseDetection
steps.stage: automated motorised (Prior Scientific H110) in heating chamber (Tokai Hit)
steps.readout: initial slope of Sox sensor fluorescence vs time (linear region fitting)

results.p_value_stimulation: 3.2e-4 (stimulated vs starved for high Akt cells)

fail.notes: 'low Akt' phenotype: neither Akt nor GAPDH affected by insulin (p=0.35, p=0.50); morphologically larger cells with higher minimum Feret diameter

steps.name: GAPDH housekeeping enzyme assay (chamber AB2) -- multiplexed loading control
steps.operation: mix (resistance-ratio passive mixing) + heat (30 C) + detect gapdhActivityDetection
steps.readout: initial slope of NADH fluorescence vs time (NAD+ to NADH conversion)

results.conclusion: GAPDH unaffected by insulin stimulation; valid loading control for per-cell normalisation
results.normalisation: Akt/GAPDH ratio per cell shows same response pattern as raw Akt (Supplementary Fig. 9)

steps.notes: Simultaneously acquired with Akt in AB1 on automated motorised stage. Encoded sequentially in BioScript (no parallel detect statements supported by lilott8/BioScript compiler).

high_akt_cells.morphology: smaller cell area, smaller minimum Feret diameter

low_akt_cells.morphology: significantly larger cell area (p=0.037) and minimum Feret diameter (p=0.0003)
low_akt_cells.putative_phenotype: consistent with cellular senescence (wider, flatter morphology; elevated SA-beta-gal activity; lower SMP-30/Akt in HepG2)

heterogeneity_in_akt_activity.note: Morphological differences not observable in flow cytometry; probe enables phenotype-signalling co-measurement from same individual cell

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.contents: device priming, BSA coating, UV bleach, buffer loading, cell plating, serum starvation, Cell Tracker labelling, insulin stimulation, lysis zone + detect

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.contents: dispose lysisSignal; Akt assay mix (90s valve travel) + heat 30C + detect aktKinaseDetection

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.contents: dispose aktSignal; GAPDH assay mix (90s valve travel) + heat 30C + detect gapdhActivityDetection
